entries.zh: 錯亂、胡言亂語；雜亂無章（說話的方式）
entries.en: absurd, nonsensical (manner of speaking); jumbled, confused
entries.notes: H 首字殘疑（插/抖），M 兩處調符 T99；按重疊音 chap chap（雜雜）取言語錯亂義。

entries.zh: （教會法上的）豁免、免除；給予准許、特許
entries.en: to dispense (from a law or obligation); to grant licence, permission
entries.notes: L 末段 [疑:missa/minis] 未定；H 末字疑（獎/辦）且與 M 音 pep 不合，義從 dispensar + licencia 定。

entries.zh: 安排得宜、處置妥當；（人的）性情、資質良好
entries.en: good disposition; proper arrangement, good order
entries.notes: H 丈 與 M tiang／R chiang 常讀不合，H 與 L 的對應未能確定。

entries.zh: 審時度勢、看情形再作安排；把事情看清楚
entries.en: to consider the situation; to arrange (a matter) with a view to circumstances
entries.notes: H 作省 而 M 音 cua 近看（khòaⁿ），整條按看時勢解。

entries.en: to set forth, lay out; to expound, state in detail
entries.notes: L yzarar 殘亂；M 另附 notificar/conversar 等西語，義從 H 敷陳 定。

entries.zh: 起草、打草稿；籌畫（該做之事）
entries.en: to draft, sketch out; to plan (what is to be done)
to pack one's luggage; to get things ready for a journey
proper, right; settled, in good order
to dispute, argue; to reason out, discuss

entries.notes: L 欄空白（原件缺），義僅依 H 議論 與 M/R 音定。

entries.en: to discuss, expound; to talk over
to dispute contentiously, argue against objections (as in litigation)
entries.notes: L ple y teando 即 pleyteando（訴訟）；M 末 vo bin trabaxo 未明。

entries.zh: 辯開、辯明而使分開；把爭執辯解開
entries.en: to argue (a matter) apart; to separate or clear up by argument
entries.notes: M uy 與 R cay 對 開 字讀音不合，義依 L 與 H 定。
M 調符污損（T99）；L/H/R 三欄互證，義無疑。

entries.en: to separate, depart; to be distant
entries.notes: M 欄例語多處 T99 污損，R 僅單字音；義依 L 與 H 離 定。
